title: Finding humor in photography
text:
Title: Finding humor in photography

In the faded golden tones of the Porsche and the lo-fi aesthetic of these 70s pieces, 
they have a glorious throwback feel to them, bringing to mind a kind of lazy afternoon Americana 
redolent of Slip ’N Slides. “They’re a simple and concise action that shows how photography can record 
these moments of magic,” Mickevicius said. “It’s just a pretty, joyous piece.” As if this isn’t enough range yet, 
for something complete different multimedia artist Steffi Faircloth’s 
Bordertown ASMR series, in which she offers short videos depicting her lived experience of the US border with Mexico.
